title: Westbrass A421-05 1-1/4" x 12" Slip Joint Extension Tube, Polished Nickel

comparisons.notes: Same Westbrass A421-05 polished nickel 1-1/4" x 12"

writeup: Westbrass A421-05 is a 1-1/4 inch by 12 inch slip-joint extension tube in polished nickel, the kind of exposed drain piece that matters under a pedestal or console sink. Woot Sellout has it for $17.99, while Mechanics Surplus lists it at $50.49.
